checks.label: Duplicate payment verification
checks.detail: No high-confidence duplicates after filtering 3517 batch payments and 5024 CSV overlaps. Previous false positives eliminated.

checks.label: Split payment analysis
checks.detail: 789 suspect instances (£129.9M, 4.7% of spend). Threshold: 5+ payments to same supplier in same week, 80%+ of approval limit.

checks.label: Year-end spike verification
checks.detail: Highest spike: 5.6x in Adult Social Care. Year-end spikes are common in public sector (capital programmes, grants). Only extreme spikes (>3x) warrant concern.

checks.label: CH breach temporal verification
checks.detail: 5 suppliers with £33.6K confirmed during active breach periods. Enrichment errors excluded. Only dated violations with confirmed overlap flagged.

checks.label: Benford's Law forensic screening
checks.detail: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). χ²=16149.25 on 656613 amounts >£100. Largest deviation: digit 1 (3.8% off expected).

warnings: Benford's Law analysis shows significant deviation (χ²=16149.25). Digit 1 deviates 3.8% from expected. This warrants investigation but can also occur with legitimate round-number grants or threshold-based payments.
